title: Blue Book analysis card: Newhouse Tremonton sighting with attached photo
description: Project Blue Book index card for CPO Delbert C. Newhouse's 2 July 1952 sighting 7 miles north of Tremonton, Utah — typed analysis ('Group of objects milling about in rough formation… Explanation — Pillow balloons or Birds') with an attached black-and-white photograph of small indistinct objects against clouds, hand-labeled 'Pillow Balloons'.
